summary: iQSTEL Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting the creation of a wholly-owned subsidiary, IQSTEL Operating Holdings Inc., effective July 2, 2026, to enhance financial transparency and support future M&A, and announcing preliminary net revenue of ~$207M for H1 2026 with 59% YoY growth, including an update on the anticipated closing of the ULTRANET acquisition in Q3 2026. This is a routine operational update and financial results disclosure, not a special situation event. The filing does not reflect a definitive agreement or structural change triggering a special-situation classification.
